External bot-protection contract address used by the checkBots modifier and list().
Public Uniswap pair address computed in constructor via pairOfTokens.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to stopTheBots before executing the wrapped function body.
BotProtected constructor assigning stopTheBots from the _botProtection argument.
Public mapping of holder balances manipulated in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of allowances written in approve and consumed in transferFrom.
Public total supply constant-initialized token amount.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for addLiquidityETH in list().
Wrapped BNB token address used to derive the pair.
ELongD constructor: sets owner=tx.origin, computes uniPair, grants unlimited allowances.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable balance/allowance mover with checkBots modifier and unchecked Solidity 0.7 arithmetic.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall into attacker-supplied address a with calldata b.
Internal pure helper deriving a Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Owner-only function that mints balance, adds liquidity with block.timestamp deadline, calls stopTheBots and loops over address/amount arrays.
External caller address used for authorization and allowance checks.
Block timestamp used to build the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Transaction origin used directly as the contract owner in the constructor.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.

External call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a timestamp-derived deadline.
Raw stopTheBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3, _toAddresses) invoked inside list() before the mint loop.

Array of amounts assigned to recipients in list().

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into the stopTheBots state variable.
BotProtected constructor writes the stopTheBots state variable.
checkBots modifier performs an external low-level call to stopTheBots before the guarded function updates state.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier invoked at function entry.
msg.sender determines the allowance branch (allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value) in transferFrom.
transferFrom performs unchecked -= and += on allowance and balanceOf in Solidity 0.7.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
Parameter _from flows into transferFrom balance and allowance operations.
Parameter _to flows into transferFrom recipient balance credit.
Parameter _value flows into transferFrom subtraction and addition operations.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
approve() writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender and _spender.
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve().
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
delegate() passes attacker-controlled address and calldata into a delegatecall.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target chosen by the caller of delegate().
Parameter b is the arbitrary calldata executed via delegatecall.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before minting balances and adding liquidity.
msg.sender is compared against owner in list() and receives minted balances.
ELongD constructor sets owner = tx.origin, making ownership depend on the transaction origin.
tx.origin is written into the owner state variable in the constructor.
Constructor calls pairOfTokens(wBNB, address(this)) to derive the pair.
pairOfTokens return value is assigned to the uniPair state variable.
Local token0 is used in the keccak256 pair-address computation.
Local token1 is used in the keccak256 pair-address computation.
block.timestamp feeds the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
list() makes an external call to uniRouter.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value.
list() calls stopTheBots with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 before the balance assignment loop.
list() writes balanceOf for address(this), msg.sender and each recipient.
list() invokes the uniRouter state variable for liquidity provision.
Parameter _numList defines the token/ETH amounts passed to addLiquidityETH.
Parameter _toAddresses is iterated to assign balances and emit transfers.
Parameter _amounts supplies minted balance values in the list loop.
Loop index i controls the address/amount assignment loop in list().
uniRouter instance is the target of the addLiquidityETH external call.
uniPair is passed as an argument into the stopTheBots call inside checkBots.
checkBots uses the stopTheBots state variable as the low-level call target.
stopTheBots address is the callee of the modifier's low-level call.
ELongD constructor stores the derived pair address into uniPair.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance entries for this contract and tx.origin.

normalization_plan.reason: _botProtection is only consumed by the BotProtected constructor to set stopTheBots.
_from is only used inside transferFrom for allowance and balance bookkeeping.
_to is only used inside transferFrom as the destination of the balance credit.
_value is only used inside transferFrom for allowance/balance arithmetic.
Parameter a is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate().
Parameter b is only used as the delegatecall payload inside delegate().
_numList is only used in list() for balance assignment and addLiquidityETH amounts.
_amounts is only used for balance assignment inside list().
token0 is a temporary of pairOfTokens used solely in the keccak pair computation.
token1 is a temporary of pairOfTokens used solely in the keccak pair computation.
Loop index i exists only inside the list() recipient loop.
